missions.title: New Job
missions.description: Five days after what happened with AR-15, the commander started a new job in Area S05 under Grifon jurisdiction.

missions.title: Sabotage
missions.description: Sangvis activities were detected along the borders of Area S05. To keep the detained AR Team safe, the commander decided to destroy the enemy forces.

missions.title: Daily Patrols
missions.description: Another day of patrol duties... I wonder if Helian would accept my request...

missions.title: Ambush
missions.description: The signal is blocked in the detention center. Meanwhile, a large number of Sangvis units have suddenly appeared within Area S05...

missions.title: Cat and Mouse
missions.description: The battle to eliminate Sangvis forces rages on and everyone is too busy to do anything else. At this moment, we receive an ecrypted communications request...

missions.title: Reunion
missions.description: We have no way of knowing the situation inside the detention center. All we can do is to prepare for the final battle. I hope the assistants sent by Persica will be of use to us...

missions.title: Retrieval I
missions.description: Nearly 40 days after the incident in Area S08, RO leads M16 and SOP2 in a mission to collect the Sangvis Scout's companion.

missions.title: Retrieval II
missions.description: M16 gets in touch with the "Palette" team and searches for SOP2 under Sangvis bombardment.

missions.title: Retrieval III
missions.description: Dreamer induces SOP2 into a fit of mind-broken rage. You must rescue the crazed SOP2 as soon as possible!

missions.title: Retrieval IV
missions.description: RO has destroyed the Jupiter Cannon, but the Commander needs to break through Dreamer's blockade and save the AR Team and the members of "Palette" who are in danger.

missions.title: One-Sided Memory I
missions.description: Negev: In a small corner of an unknown battlefield, Jericho and I are huddled up, waiting for a rescue that may never come…

missions.title: One-Sided Memory II
missions.description: Negev: In the darkness engulfed by fear and despair, I reminisce about a glorious victory of the past…

missions.title: One-Sided Memory III
missions.description: Negev: We rekindle our hearts with this memory and reach for an already-irresversible future…

missions.title: One-Sided Memory IV
missions.description: Negev: In the end, I woke up and remembered everything…
